name: curNode
meaning: index into g_ghostNodes of the node the ghost last reached; set from Ghost_FindNearestNode at init/reset (0x44b1c1) and from nextNode on arrival (0x44bdb8)

name: nextNode
meaning: index of the node being travelled to (Ghost_PickNextNode result, 0x44bc82); node pair used for the patrol segment and the capture camera

name: avoidNode
meaning: node index the picker must not turn back to; 0x25 (= no node) at init, reset and on msg 0x4001 (0x44d101), set to curNode when a node is reached (0x44bda1)

name: activationBox
meaning: PROPERTY_GHOST_ACTIVATIONBOX via Scn_GetPropBox(record, 0) (0x44b153); only ever tested against the Wolf into wolfInBox

name: travel
meaning: current travel leg: target point, speed, heading and arrive radius; filled by Ghost_SetTravel (0x44e947), consumed by Ghost_StepTravel (0x44ea01)

name: chaseRange
meaning: state 7 leash: set to 99999 on entering the chase (0x44d60a) and then to wolfDist every frame (0x44c9c5); the chase gives up when wolfDist grows past it

name: state
meaning: 0 idle .. 9 boo-wait; written by Ghost_SetState (0x44d276) and twice directly in Update (0x44c715 = 3, 0x44c848 = 1, 0x44ce68 = 2)

name: prevState
meaning: state before the last Ghost_SetState (0x44d26a); Ghost_PickNextNode treats prevState == 1 specially and Update sets it to 1 at 0x44c16c

name: rethink
meaning: set by message 0x4002 (0x44d11e); Ghost_PickNextNode consumes it (0x44e8d2-0x44e8de) and then returns the runner-up neighbour instead of the best one

name: hoover
meaning: the Hoover (class 131) found by Scenaric_FindByClass at init (0x44b185); told 0x4583 when the suck finishes (0x44ca32)

name: homePos
meaning: position of the nearest node at init, pushed through SetPosition (0x44b3c9) and re-applied on reset (0x44b49d)

name: capturePos
meaning: the Wolf's position when the capture (state 4) started (0x44d686); the capture step holds him there (0x44c412-0x44c44b)

name: vulnerable
meaning: argument of message 0x4001 from the Hoover (0x44d0ee); non-zero makes the ghost blue and sends it to the flee state 3 instead of chasing

name: wolfInBox
meaning: whether the Wolf was inside activationBox on x and z when Init/Reset ran (0x44b2a4, 0x44b54f); never read anywhere in the class

name: beingSucked
meaning: 1 from the Hoover's suck message 0 (0x44d184) until the next reset; blocks the idle state's SetVisible and the patrol transitions

name: master
meaning: PROPERTY_GHOST_MASTER (record property +4, read in Ghost_Create 0x44da00); non-zero on exactly one ghost, which builds the shared node graph

name: wolfBooed
meaning: set by message 0x70 (the Wolf's boo broadcast) in states 8/9 (0x44d086); polled as Wolf message 0x412 each frame (0x44b6e2)

name: cameraArmed
meaning: 1 at init and reset (0x44b481); the capture state starts the scripted camera only while it is set (0x44d774) and clears it on the boo path (0x44cad4, 0x44cb65, 0x44cd52, 0x44cead, 0x44d87f)

name: unkCC
meaning: zeroed by Init, Reset and message 0xE (0x44d130); nothing in the class ever sets it

name: booCount
meaning: number of boos answered; incremented on entering state 9 (0x44d861) and at 3 the ghost gives up and captures (0x44d87a)

name: fadeDir
meaning: +1 fading to the vulnerable blue, -1 fading back, 0 idle; set from the 0x4001 argument (0x44d0c5 / 0x44d0d9)

name: tintR
meaning: low byte of the tint colour being faded (0x44b80c)

name: tintG
meaning: middle byte of the faded tint colour (0x44b84c)

name: tintB
meaning: high byte of the faded tint colour (0x44b88c)

name: baseR
meaning: the model's own tint bytes, saved at init (0x44b2cd) and restored when the fade ends (0x44bb86)

name: baseG
meaning: saved tint byte 1 (0x44b2dc)

name: baseB
meaning: saved tint byte 2 (0x44b2eb)

name: fadeSteps
meaning: 10 when a fade starts (0x44d0f7), decremented once per frame (0x44b89e); at 0 the end colour is written outright

name: tintScratch
meaning: member used as scratch while packing tintB/tintG/tintR into the tint colour (0x44b8c0-0x44b944)

name: wolfDist
meaning: Vec3s_DistXZ(wolf.pos, pos) each frame (0x44b6a8), forced to 3000 while the Wolf is in the ghost costume (0x44b6fd)

name: stepR
meaning: per-frame tint delta toward the vulnerable blue 0x6E (0x44b302): 0x6E - baseR

name: stepG
meaning: 0xB4 - baseG (0x44b31a)

name: stepB
meaning: 0xFA - baseB (0x44b332)

name: turnRate
meaning: angular velocity accumulator handed to Math_ApproachAngle by Ghost_TurnToward (0x44eada)

name: ghosts
meaning: the other Ghosts (class 120) from Scenaric_FindByClass (0x44b167); messaged 0x4002 when one comes within 240 units and 0x4003 when this one captures

name: ghostCount
meaning: count written by Scenaric_FindByClass (0x44b172)

name: capturedSheep
meaning: embedded ScnBody built from export 0xBF (0x44b3d8); shown at the ghost's position during the capture animation

name: capturedSheepRecord
meaning: synthetic record for that body (Scn_BuildRecordFromExport 0x44b3de)

name: hasCapturedSheep
meaning: 1 when the export resolved and the body was initialised (0x44b40e)

name: showCapturedSheep
meaning: 1 while the capture animation runs (0x44d767); Render draws the embedded body only then and only in state 4 (0x44d92d)

name: fireballTimerMs
meaning: 1150 ms at capture (0x44d66b), counted down by g_dtMs; at 0 the FireBall is told 0x5981 every frame (0x44c3ab)

name: soundHandle
meaning: handle of the last Sound_Play (0x44d384, 0x44d7fb), stopped before the next one
